description: Phase 1 offline dependency inventory. Each item is something the Phase 1 workflow needs after installation; installDownload says whether installation fetches it. scripts/check-offline.mjs fails on a network origin missing from networkOrigins, an npm runtime package whose license is not in allowedLicenses, or a listed file whose bytes or SHA-256 changed. Terrain sources are in data/terrain/inventory.json. Nothing here is downloaded automatically.

networkOrigins.reason: The loopback bridge, local preview servers and Worker checks bind to the local machine only.
Local preview server of scripts/probe-laptop.mjs.
Local preview server of scripts/check-gpu-perf.mjs.
Base URL for resolving relative material URLs and the local tiles-worker development binding.
Default Vite development origin accepted by the loopback bridge.
JSON Schema draft-07 $schema identifier; never fetched.
JSON Schema 2020-12 $schema identifier; never fetched.
Reserved .invalid $id of the Control Protocol v2 schema; never resolvable.
Internal Durable Object request URL inside the tiles worker; it never leaves the worker.
XML and SVG namespace identifiers inside bundled libraries; never fetched.
Pinned source clones for builds (ArduPilot, MAVLink definitions, Rapier, emsdk, JSBSim) and source citations; nothing is fetched at run time.
Pinned ArduPilot source files recorded with SHA-256 in native/ardupilot/source.lock.json for the TASK-045 build check.
ArduPilot documentation cited in tooling comments.
Citation of NASA TM X-3561 for the landing-gear drop fixture.
Citation of the NREL AirfoilPrep reference in the airfoil-input audit.
Citation of the UIUC propeller and airfoil coordinate databases; the data were provided offline.
License URL recorded for ESA WorldCover (CC BY 4.0).
Dataset DOI recorded for ESA WorldCover.
Error-message links inside the bundled React production build.
Documentation link inside the bundled react-three-fiber build.
Shader credit comment inside a bundled three.js shader.
FABDEM V1-2 archives read only when an operator runs scripts/geodata/fetch_fabdem.py by hand.
EGM2008 geoid grid fetched only by the manual geodata environment setup (scripts/geodata/setup-wsl.sh).
.NET SDK installer for the 3D Tiles converters, fetched only by the manual geodata environment setup.
FLIR ADAS thermal sample fetched only by scripts/geodata/fetch_flir_sample.py after the operator accepts the dataset terms.
FLIR ADAS dataset agreement page cited by the sample fetcher.
Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles upstream of the optional tiles worker; needs keys and a deployment and is never an offline source.

items.item: MirageSITL web application, Workers and loopback bridge (apps/web, apps/bridge, packages/*)
items.source: This repository; npm run build produces apps/web/dist
items.license: Project-owned; the repository declares no license
items.notes: Built locally from the checkout. node scripts/check-offline.mjs --dist apps/web/dist checks the built bundle's network origins.

items.item: Runtime npm packages from package-lock.json (react, react-dom, three, @react-three/fiber, 3d-tiles-renderer, pmtiles, ws, zustand and their dependencies)
items.license: MIT, ISC, BSD-3-Clause and Apache-2.0; scripts/check-offline.mjs checks every runtime package's declared license
items.neededFor: The web application bundle and the loopback bridge

items.item: Development npm packages (Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, Playwright, ESLint and their dependencies)
items.license: Per package; build tools only, not shipped in the bundle
items.neededFor: Building the bundle and running the checks

items.neededFor: Build, local tooling, the loopback bridge and the planned local launcher (TASK-151)

items.item: Rust toolchain with the wasm32-unknown-unknown target
items.neededFor: Building the BET and contact WebAssembly artifacts
